answer: In a market for spiral designs, lotus images and timber estimates, allocate paid review jobs by a lottery over locked collateral units, with no minimum prize per account. Sample units uniformly and reserve the selected collateral until the review can be audited. Splitting 100 units across a thousand aliases leaves their combined selection chance unchanged. An attacker must lock more capital to win more jobs and risks losing the reserved units for provably false reviews. This limits alias leverage but does not stop a wealthy cartel.
